## Appendix: KLD charts (generated by `bench/perf/kld_charts.py`)

Generated from the committed score and paired-difference files listed in `sources.json` (sha256 per file). Reference: Q8_0. Each chart is followed by a table twin with every plotted value, its source file and field. "Resolved" means the 95% CI of the paired difference excludes 0 (a CI that touches 0 is within noise). Colors: llama.cpp, radiance and sly vLLM are fixed family colors; every mark also has a direct label.
